## D — Accuracy and verification, Driving record, points and alcohol

Section D records the accuracy posture for driving record, points and alcohol. Every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 traces to exactly one cited physical handbook page, and that page states the fact in full. Confidence is high across the section because every rule comes from the single pinned October edition of the handbook. No fact needed a lower confidence flag, so no verification debt was opened and no external review was requested. Handbook wording is paraphrased throughout; no official sentence, table, image or sample question is reproduced. Point values, blood alcohol limits and sanction lengths are recorded exactly as printed in the pinned edition; no figure was taken from outside the handbook. No location-variable fact needed isolation as dynamic knowledge.
